author: OpenBank Security
notes: Scope: the release VEX of wealth-service-v0.3.2 lists exactly one finding, CVE-2025-14969 (under_investigation), from the release SBOM scan; this overlay records the verdict for that finding only. It does not cover container OS packages. Reassess when the resolved hibernate-reactive-core artifact or the scanner findings change.

statements.impact_statement: Verified for this component, not inherited: `./gradlew :openbank-wealth-service:dependencies --configuration runtimeClasspath` (run 2026-11-01 against origin/main ebb47e7d1) resolves org.hibernate.reactive:hibernate-reactive-core to 3.4.2.Final. The advisory's single-interval range (< 4.2.1) spans parallel release lines and does not classify the 3.4.x line, which was released after the fix. The resolved jar's sha256 is 7e7443b2b5313b043af3d9448499f44059fa77729ddb9e369c4a2b9a9cea075c, the value pinned in gradle/verification-metadata.xml, so the inspected bytes are the shipped bytes. `javap -p -c` of that jar shows the effects of upstream fix commit cd7f104e10de918004707ca0e26e3840976f780a: SqlClientConnection.close() invokes validateNoTransactionInProgressOnClose(), the class carries the post-fix 'private boolean closed' field, and Log declares liveTransactionDetectedOnClose(). The probe's ability to discriminate (fix absent in 4.2.0.Final, present in 4.2.1.Final) was established when the fleet overlays recorded this verdict (#4533/#4707); it was not re-run for this statement. The vulnerable close implementation is not present in the resolved artifact.
